$comment: The league task list (docs/leagues.md, Tasks), used by plugins/modes/LeagueTasks.plugin.js; the catalog itself is the generated league-tasks.json. From the rev 241 cache: the list interface league_tasks (657) draws its rows from enum `taskEnum` (position -> a row of DB table `table`, `action`, whose columns are listed), takes a tier's points from enum `pointsEnum`, and reads a task's completion as bit (position % 32) of the `completionVarps` (script 9470: 2616-2631 for positions 0-511, 2808-2835 for 512-1407, 3339-3342 for 1408-1535, 4036-4049 for 1536-1983); the recordings never carry those varps, the scripts read them, so we send them. A league's own catalog goes to the client as enumOverrides (the task enum, the points enum) and dbRowOverrides (rows `virtualRowBase` + league type x 10000 + position). From rsprox Leagues V recordings (osrs-captures 227/00070, 00067, 00068, 01710): View Tasks (656:36) opens 657 in the toplevel floater as an overlay with if_setevents OP1 on the five dropdowns' option lists, the task rows (0..task count) and the menu frame; a dropdown option slot N sets its filter varbit to N - 1 (captured for the tier and completed-style dropdowns; the rest follow their enums); a row click is answered with nothing (expand/collapse is the client's); the close button closes the floater; a completed task adds the game message in the league's colour after LeaguePoints' varps and popup. The recordings are revision 227, where the option lists were 657:35-39 and the rows 657:17; this cache (241) names them dropdown_tier 657:37, dropdown_type 38, dropdown_area 39, dropdown_skill 40, dropdown_completed 42 (the components the filter rows' scripts, 3207, build each list in) and the rows' Expand ops sit on tasks_background 657:18, so those take the events here (the cache wins on ids). league_reward_points_buffer (13341) animates the side panel's bar on live (10 then 0) and is not sent.
